author: Seung Wook
problem: A bike shop's bill is the cost of parts plus hours of labour at rate per hour, and 20% VAT is added to the bill. Return the total to pay, rounded to cents.
bug_description: Leaves out the parentheses, so VAT is added only to the labour and the parts are charged without it.

comments.accurate: Bill total for parts and labour with 20% VAT added
comments.wrong_behavior: Bill total: parts at cost, plus labour charged with 20% VAT
comments.wrong_location: VAT calculation verified; check the labour charge multiplies hours by the rate
